items.question: How do I get started with the bot?
items.answer: After creating your account, connect your WhatsApp number by scanning the QR code from the dashboard. Then create auto-reply rules and you'll be ready in minutes.

items.question: Does the bot work 24/7?
items.answer: Yes, the bot works around the clock. You can also set specific working hours and customize out-of-office messages.

items.question: How does Google Sheets sync work?
items.answer: Sync happens automatically. Every incoming and outgoing message is saved to Google Sheets with sender info and timestamp. Access your data anytime.

items.question: Can I customize the replies?
items.answer: Yes, you can create unlimited reply rules based on keywords, phrases, or even complex patterns using regular expressions (Regex).

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: We accept major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) and Mada. For enterprise plans, we accept bank transfers.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Yes, all our plans have no long-term contracts. You can cancel from your account settings and continue using the service until the end of the current billing period.

triggerTypes.title: Trigger Types

exact.description: Message must match the trigger exactly (case-insensitive).

contains.description: Message contains the trigger phrase anywhere.

startsWith.description: Message starts with the trigger phrase.

regex.description: Use regular expressions for complex pattern matching.

priority.title: Priority System
priority.description: When multiple rules could match a message, the rule with the highest priority number is used. Set important rules to higher priority values.

example.title: Priority Example
example.note: Higher priority rules are checked first. VIP greeting (100) takes precedence over general greeting (50).
